body:
## Summary

Updates the installed Sepo agent infrastructure from **0.4.0** to **v0.5.0** (`5f7d2032080e9c0578d0e4cb3b98b2f695f33547`, resolved as the latest published release).

- Source: `self-evolving/repo` @ `v0.5.0` / `5f7d2032080e9c0578d0e4cb3b98b2f695f33547`
- Target branch: `main` → update branch `agent/update-agent-infra-20260801`
- 57 files changed, scoped to `.agent/`, `.github/`, and a new root `.gitignore`
- No files removed (obsolete-file removal was not requested)

The merge was conservative: stock-0.4.0 Sepo files were cleanly updated, new 0.5.0 files were added, and every file the target had customized was three-way merged or preserved rather than overwritten.

## Changed path groups

- `.agent/` runtime, docs, tooling, tests, `package.json` / `package-lock.json` / `model-defaults.json`
- `.github/` workflows, actions, prompts
- root `.gitignore` (created)

## Audit summary

Each Sepo-owned file was compared three ways (stock 0.4.0 vs. target vs. 0.5.0) to separate version changes from target customizations.

**Clean updates** (target matched stock 0.4.0 → updated to 0.5.0): all `.agent/docs/*` except `supported-workflows.md`; `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `model-defaults.json`; `acpx-adapter.ts`, `cli/extract-context.ts`, `github.ts`, `run.ts`; `acpx-adapter.test.ts`, `resolve-agent-provider.test.ts`, `envelope.test.ts`, `workflow-action-validation.test.ts`; all `tools/local-runner/*`; `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js`; `.github/actions/setup-agent-runtime/action.yml`; prompts `agent-answer.md`, `agent-install.md`, `agent-update.md`; workflows `agent-entrypoint.yml`, `agent-router.yml`, `agent-update.yml`.

**New Sepo files added:** `.agent/README.md`; `self-improvement.ts`, `self-improvement-requester.ts`, `cli/apply-self-improvement-decision.ts`, `cli/resolve-self-improvement-requester.ts` and their tests; `scripts/test/cli-cache-keys.test.cjs`; `tools/local-runner/.gitignore`; `.github/prompts/agent-self-improvement.md`; `.github/workflows/agent-cache-seed.yml`; `.github/workflows/agent-self-improvement.yml`.

**Three-way merged (target customization + 0.5.0 change, both kept):**
- `.agent/src/triage.ts` — kept the target's `chat` → `answer` route alias (`canonicalizeExplicitRouteCommand`) **and** added Sepo's new `parseTriageMode` / `TriageMode`. One adjacent-insertion conflict was resolved by keeping both functions.
- `.agent/src/__tests__/triage.test.ts`, `.agent/src/__tests__/extract-context-cli.test.ts` — merged cleanly.
- `.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md` — kept the target's `agent-review-nudge.yml` documentation **and** Sepo's 0.5.0 rewrite.

**Preserved as-is (Sepo made no 0.5.0 change; target customization kept):** `.agent/src/discussion.ts`, `.agent/src/__tests__/discussion.test.ts`, `.agent/src/__tests__/onboarding-check-cli.test.ts`.

**Preserved against a 0.5.0 change (see note below):** `.github/workflows/test-scripts.yml`.

**Excluded orphan:** `.github/assets/sepo-headline.png` was **not** copied — it is referenced only by the Sepo root `README.md`, which is out of scope for this update; the target uses its own `assets/lean-workspace-teaser.png`.

**Root `.gitignore`:** the target had none, so a minimal one was created with `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/` so GitHub-hosted runner builds do not leak generated files into PRs.

## Customizations preserved (target-owned, untouched)

Custom runtime: `.agent/src/deployments.ts`, `literature-update.ts`, `review-nudge.ts`, and `cli/{inactivate-preview-deployments,post-review-nudge,publish-canonical-deployment,publish-literature-update,publish-preview-deployment}.ts` (+ their tests). Custom `.github`: workflows `lean.yml`, `deploy.yml`, `bump-mathlib.yml`, `agent-deploy-site-main.yml`, `agent-review-nudge.yml`, `agent-site-preview.yml`; prompts `literature-add-paper.md`, `literature-daily.md`; actions `deploy-sepo-site`, `resolve-discussion-ids`; `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*`; `assets/lean-workspace-teaser.png`; `dependabot.yml`; `pull_request_template.md`. Root `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` and the root `README.md` were left untouched (not requested).

## ⚠️ Decision needed: `test-scripts.yml`

The target has overloaded the Sepo-owned `test-scripts.yml` with **project** CI — Quartz site validation, `npm run test:blueprint`, and the Quartz component tests. These project **unit** tests run only in this workflow on PRs (site builds are also covered by `lean.yml` / `deploy.yml`, but the blueprint model tests and Quartz component tests are not).

Sepo's 0.5.0 change to this file (a) restricts the `pull_request` trigger to agent-owned paths and (b) gates the job to `github.repository == 'self-evolving/repo' || vars.AGENT_TEST_SCRIPTS_ENABLED == 'true'`. Applied verbatim to this repo, that would **silently disable the target's blueprint/Quartz unit-test CI on PRs**, so `test-scripts.yml` was **preserved** rather than overwritten.

Consequence: the Sepo self-test `packaged Sepo workflows have a global AGENT_ENABLED job guard` (in `envelope.test.ts`, updated to 0.5.0) asserts the pristine 0.5.0 `test-scripts.yml` shape and therefore **fails** against the preserved file. This is the single expected validation failure below.

Suggested reconciliation (maintainer's call):
1. Adopt Sepo's pristine 0.5.0 `test-scripts.yml` and move the project unit tests (`test:blueprint`, Quartz component tests) into a dedicated project-CI workflow triggered on project paths — self-test passes, coverage preserved.
2. Keep the customized `test-scripts.yml` and accept that this Sepo self-test will keep diverging on future updates.

## Validation

Run in `.agent/` on this branch:

- `npm ci` — OK (47 packages, new 0.5.0 Codex/ACPX deps)
- `npm run build` (tsc) — OK; the merged `triage.ts` and all target-custom runtime compile against 0.5.0 core
- `npm test` lanes:
  - runtime — **780 / 780 pass**
  - docs — **5 / 5 pass**
  - shell — **17 / 17 pass**
  - workflow — **90 / 91 pass**; the one failure is `packaged Sepo workflows have a global AGENT_ENABLED job guard`, caused solely by preserving the customized `test-scripts.yml` (see decision above)
- All `.github/workflows/*.yml` parse as YAML objects
- `git diff --check` / `git diff --cached --check` — clean; no `.agent/dist` or `.agent/node_modules` leaked into the diff

No checks were skipped.

## Memory / rubrics branch status

- `agent/memory` — **exists** (`e4c11da…`); not reinitialized.
- `agent/rubrics` — **missing**; not created here.
- `refs/agent-state/*` (scheduled-update state) — untouched.

## Post-merge notes (document only)

- After merge, `agent-cache-seed.yml` will run on the default branch (it triggers on `.agent/**` changes) to warm the runtime caches — expected 0.5.0 behavior.
- `agent-self-improvement.yml` is **opt-in**: it stays disabled unless `vars.AGENT_SELF_IMPROVEMENT_ENABLED == 'true'` (and `AGENT_ENABLED != 'false'`).
- Verify provider secrets (`OPENAI_API_KEY` / `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) and the Sepo App still satisfy the updated workflows.
- `agent/memory` exists — do not reinitialize; ongoing memory sync/scan workflows apply.
- If rubric steering is wanted, optionally run `Agent / Rubrics / Initialization`.
- This refresh bootstraps future dedicated-route (`agent-update.yml`) infrastructure updates.
title: Update Sepo from 0.4.0 to v0.5.0/5f7d2032080e9c0578d0e4cb3b98b2f695f33547
